tree.heading: In General.—
tree.text: In carrying out work under reimbursable agreements with any State, local, or tribal government, the Secretary, without regard to any provision of law or a regulation—

children.text: may record obligations against accounts receivable from those governments; and
shall credit amounts received from those governments to the appropriate account.

tree.heading: When Amounts Shall Be Credited.—
tree.text: Amounts shall be credited within 90 days of the date of the original request by the Service for payment.
